spring_term_dates.notes: Spring arrival/orientation timing pattern from data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Spring 2025 Exchange Quick Facts.pdf#page=1.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=9
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from AY2024-25 semester estimate in Guide p.9 divided across a 5-month semester: Housing $4,000-$6,500 + Meal Plan $500-$1,500 + Additional Meals $1,000 + Spending Money $2,000 = $7,500-$11,000/semester ($1,500-$2,200/month). Excludes $1,000/sem mandatory insurance; Auburn ISSS 2027-2028 COA (https://www.auburn.edu/academic/international/isss/cost-of-attendance.html) lists $15,000/yr living expenses.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=9
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester midpoint of $7,500-$11,000/semester living expenses (Housing $4,000-$6,500 + Meal Plan $500-$1,500 + Additional Meals $1,000 + Spending Money $2,000 = $9,250 midpoint) from Guide p.9. Excludes $1,000/sem mandatory health insurance and waived tuition/fees.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition, Student Fees, and International Student Fee are waived during orientation check-in. Mandatory Auburn University Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Alabama; cannot be waived by exchange students) estimated at $1,000/semester in AY2024-25 guide ($2,317/year in 2027-2028 ISSS COA). Mandatory meal plan ($500-$1,500/semester) also applies.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=9
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Non-waivable SHIP policy detailed at data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=13; 2027-2028 annual SHIP rate ($2,317) from https://www.auburn.edu/academic/international/isss/cost-of-attendance.html.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=12
housing_availability.notes: Guide p.12 notes limited on-campus availability via University Housing portal (recommended) alongside independent off-campus search options.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing is recommended (limited availability; opens ~Feb 15 for Fall / Sept for Spring via https://universityhousing.auburn.edu/; Quad, Village, South Donahue suites, and 160 Ross apartment-style recommended as open during holiday breaks; AY2024-25 rates $4,000-$6,500/semester incl. utilities/internet/laundry). Required meal plan ($500-$1,500/sem). Off-campus resources at https://offcampushousing.auburn.edu/housing.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=12
housing_notes.notes: Holiday-break recommendation (160 Ross) and arrival hotel guidance on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=11; meal plan cost on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=9.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa required (Form DS-2019 processed by ISSS ~1 week after undergraduate admission / ~2 weeks after graduate admission and mailed physically for U.S. Embassy/Consulate interview; exact visa wait times vary by country). Financial Statement in application checklist must show at least $5,000 USD per semester; passport valid 6+ months post-program.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=10
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Financial Statement threshold ($5,000/term) and 6-month passport validity from data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=7.

course_catalog_url.notes: Tentative per-term course lookup via Dynamic Schedule (https://ssbprod.auburn.edu/pls/PROD/bwckschd.p_disp_dyn_sched) cited in data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=14.

english_course_list_url.notes: All Auburn courses except foreign languages are taught in English (Guide p.14); filter term offerings in https://bulletin.auburn.edu/coursesofinstruction/ or Dynamic Schedule.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit hours; J-1 full-time minimum is 12 credit hours/semester for undergraduates (typically 4-5 classes) and 9 credit hours/semester for graduate students (typically 3 classes).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=15

course_restrictions_note.value: Course availability depends on seats and AU faculty advisor approval (Business majors and students without an AU advisor coordinate with the Auburn Abroad Exchange Coordinator); specific courses cannot be guaranteed.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=14
course_restrictions_note.notes: Priority consideration recommendation continued on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=15.

value: Financial Statement (>= $5,000 USD/semester in student's or signed sponsor's name)
Resume / CV (required for Engineering and certain majors)

required_application_docs.notes: Post-acceptance ClearWave immunization and negative TB skin test medical clearance also required (data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=5, #page=13).

academic_style.value: Public land-grant research university (est. 1856, ~30,000 enrolled students, 150+ majors across 13 colleges); uses Canvas LMS and semester coursework with dedicated Finals Period.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=4
academic_style.notes: Finals Period on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=6; Canvas LMS on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=10.

international_support_services.value: Auburn Abroad advising, 2-day pre-term orientation, ISSS immigration & DS-2019 advising (intledu@auburn.edu), AU Medical Clinic & ClearWave support, Global Tigers Association (2 events/mo), 300+ clubs via AU Involve, Tiger Transit, Night Security Shuttle, and Atlanta Airport Groome Shuttle.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=5
international_support_services.notes: ISSS details on data/raw/factsheets/Auburn/Auburn University Incoming Exchange Student Guide AY23-24 (1).pdf#page=10 & #page=23; shuttle on #page=11; clubs & GTA on #page=19.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Nomination: Feb 1 - Mar 15, Application: Feb 1 - Apr 1; Spring Nomination: Sep 1 - Oct 15, Application: Sep 1 - Nov 15 (rolling weekly review; commitment paperwork due 2 weeks pre-arrival).
